svg.title: EvoLink-Bench overview
svg.desc: Two task streams illustrate factual revision and reuse of a prepared feature table. Each turn permits bounded retries. Reset, Frozen and Evolving control state persistence and explicit post-turn updates. The evaluator measures task reward, retry recovery, state changes and later probe performance.

g.text: From one turn to the next
Retries are bounded. The last submission sets the reward.
